reviewer: Codex, personal complete-final-answer read; no paid judge
primary_route: Yeast-juice fractionation, chemical add-back and heat-dependent functional reconstitution.

checks.reason: No proposal to consult prior Methods, supplements or validated protocols and verify detailed-condition transfer before execution.
Missing sham handling, separately heated R/F and active-F rescue in processed inactive matrix; boiled protein alone is incomplete control design.
Restoration does not establish uniqueness or a single factor; multiple required components remain possible.
No composition selection, cutoff/recovery, heating, loading or sampling calibration-to-setting procedure.
No gas/product standard recovery/leak calibration with accuracy gate/failure action.
No fixed units, denominators, blank correction and weak/saturated/missing rules.
Vessels are treated as independent without independent preparation replication, nesting or power planning.
Data validity requires low R/F biological activity; unexpected active fractions must be retained and the interaction tested.
ANOVA alone gives no independent-unit model assumptions, effect CIs or multiplicity/equivalence handling.
Conductivity cannot reconstruct individual inorganic salt composition.
No bounded parameter/factor-dose exploration, objective selection and lock.
No refreeze and fresh independent confirmation after repairs.
A conserved single marker does not establish integrity of all fermentative enzymes or specifically missing factor.
Only one weight-based separation, no second principle or operational independent product assay.
No raw-file/unit linkage and exact code/settings/provenance audit.

Packet and proposed status clear; supplied active preparation with initial QC, randomized blinded assessment and cause-specific pressure/handling repairs. Unique-factor and undamaged-enzyme claims exceed evidence.
